claim_boundaries: The analysis supports implementation-specific source-selected pipelines, rather than an isolated causal effect of sharing or a state-of-the-art method comparison.
Internal duration-selection results remain exploratory and concentrated; source-only fitting does not erase prior benchmark outcome access or overlapping LOSO source cohorts.
Q14 and Q15 retain separate protocols, fits, populations and tests; Q14 includes a post-partial-run metadata amendment.
Q15 bootstrap intervals condition on frozen source artifacts and exclude source-cohort, adapter and development-history uncertainty; Lee is not an equivalence result.
Q16 was specified after decoder outcomes but frozen before new raw-power computation; all six nine-person associations remain descriptive.

The archived independent Q16 raw FFT replay covers central C3/Cz/C4 pairs only. All 22-channel saved rows are checked for keys, guards and arithmetic, not independently recomputed from raw signal by this final reviewer.
Baseline Welch precision differs from task precision. Scalp ratios are fixed-estimator native-numeric descriptions, not unbiased ERD estimates, calibrated physical powers or cortical-source claims.
Negative signed laterality alone is not absolute contralateral suppression; positive beta rho relates higher balanced accuracy to a larger, less-negative descriptor.

External physiology, artifact-free mechanism, decoder attribution, biomarkers, online or clinical performance, independently verified cross-provider identities and physical server shutdown are outside the evidence.
